dependency_text: The birth choices, closures and counts of LOCAL-COMMUTE; the maximum's matching at the ring (MOST-FAILING); the four-knot closure's qubit reading (TOY-PHASE); the separability argument for readers whom no knot joins (THIRD-READER).
objective: At the owner's go-ahead ("Let's take on 1") on direction 1 of MOST-FAILING-20261127-001: at each of the 1,177 grown closures where birth choices attain an odd close (LOCAL-COMMUTE-20261127-001), search the odd birth choices exactly for a split into readers: sets of distinctions whose values commute with every other reader's, with no knot holding two values of one reader; strictly, each reader holding two values that fail to commute. Count where splits exist and their fewest readers, verify each by a realization local to the readers, and repeat on the 173 finished census types. G18 Comparing growth laws.
